lines.t: He sits alone at the crack screen, narrow Drowning in a shine that can't hide the rot inside

All I ever knew

A voice cuts straight through his armor

Questions echo through his histories always
Down corridors, wallpaper
With violence and lies
Raised in a land drunk on sin
Pride and perversion
The Lord takes his hand

Childhood meals of poison, doctrine, and dead religion
In a nation laughing while it burns

Yeah, I wish you would break me, weigh me, but I

On me

And I won't turn from him again
